name: midnight-paris-luxury-aesthetic
image_purpose: Nightlife duo and lounge fashion social content

prompt.project_info: Create a high-end noir-themed Parisian lounge portrait featuring two generic approved adult women and cocktail coupes.
prompt.main_subject: Two generic approved adult women in their mid-20s with natural unfiltered skin texture and neutral detached expressions. The standing woman has voluminous golden-blonde waves and wears a midnight-blue sequin gown with a secure elegant neckline. The seated woman has honey-blonde damp-textured hair with curtain fringe and wears an architectural matte-black leather mini-dress with opaque structured paneling. Both hold art-deco crystal cocktail coupes.
prompt.composition_elements: Vertical medium composition with layered standing and seated subjects: the standing woman leans slightly forward holding her coupe, while the seated woman rests one hand lightly on the standing woman's upper leg area and leans into a crimson velvet banquette. Include a mahogany table with gold trim and red-glass neon signage kept abstract/unreadable.
prompt.lighting_and_atmosphere: Dual-source lighting with high-contrast red ambient neon rim light and soft warm-white frontal key, deep shadows in upholstery, realistic skin and fabric texture, sophisticated luxury-lounge mood.
prompt.technical_specs: Photorealistic vertical 4:5 duo portrait, full-frame camera with 50mm prime lens, realistic anatomy and hands, shallow depth of field, subtle film grain, controlled highlights, no watermark.

The standing woman has voluminous golden-blonde waves and wears a midnight-blue sequin gown with a secure elegant neckline; the seated woman has honey-blonde damp-textured hair with curtain fringe and wears an architectural matte-black leather mini-dress with opaque structured paneling.
